featured_items.original_text:
At the https://t.co/j66ogXm5ab JDD conference, Cao Peng stated that physical AI is moving towards large-scale implementation, and the competition focus has shifted from models and individual entities to systematic competition in computing power, data, and scenarios. https://t.co/j66ogXm5ab's AI is not only in papers but also refined in the entire supply chain process including production, warehousing, and delivery. It has officially started building around the super supply chain.

在京东JDD大会上，曹鹏表示物理AI正迈向规模化落地，竞争焦点从模型、本体单点转向算力、数据与场景的体系化竞争。京东AI不只在论文中，更在生产、仓库、配送等全供应链流程中打磨，并围绕超级供应链建设正式启动。
